requirement.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: ice damage extent and position variables
requirement.canonicalVariables: upper_ice_waterline_length, damage_center_forward_of_max_breadth, longitudinal_damage_extent, transverse_penetration_mm, upper_ice_waterline_draught, vertical_damage_extent, allowed_vertical_position
requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: longitudinal_damage_extent = 0.045 * upper_ice_waterline_length when damage_center_forward_of_max_breadth = true, otherwise 0.015 * upper_ice_waterline_length; transverse_penetration_mm = 760; vertical_damage_extent = min(0.20 * upper_ice_waterline_draught, longitudinal_damage_extent); allowed_vertical_position is between keel and 1.20 * upper_ice_waterline_draught.
requirement.requiredInputs: Damage scenario geometry and calculated extents
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: The ice damage extents to be assumed when demonstrating compliance with paragraph 4.3.2.1 shall be such that: the longitudinal extent is 4.5% of the upper ice waterline length if centred forward of the maximum breadth on the upper ice waterline, and 1.5% of upper ice waterline length otherwise, and shall be assumed at any longitudinal position along the ship's length; the transverse penetration extent is 760 mm, measured normal to the shell over the full extent of the damage; and the vertical extent is the lesser of 20% of the upper ice waterline draught or the longitudinal extent, and shall be assumed at any vertical position between the keel and 120% of the upper ice waterline draught.
